feeds.title: Life in the Fastpitch Lane
feeds.description: Ken Krause, owner and lead instructor of Softball Success, has been coaching girls fastpitch softball for nearly 20 years. This blog is about thoughts, ideas and musings on fast-pitch softball.

feeds.title: Little League News
feeds.description: Founded in 1939, Little League Baseball and Softball is the world's largest organized youth sports program, with millions of players and more than one million adult volunteers in every U.S. state and more than 80 other countries. The basic goal remains the same, to give the children of the world a game that provides fundamental principles they can use later in life to become good citizens.

feeds.title: Alan's College Softball Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with Alan's College Softball Blog.

feeds.title: Softball is for Girls Blog
feeds.description: Softball Is For Girls, Empowering the players, parents, coaches and fans of girls fastpitch softball! Check out our store for softball shirts, bags & more! Empowering the players, parents, coaches and fans of girls fastpitch softball!

feeds.title: The National Club Softball Association | NCSA
feeds.description: The National Club Softball Association (NCSA) is the only inter-collegiate club softball league in the United States. We are driven to provide collegiate student-athletes with the opportunity to play competitive, organized college softball and to continually improve this experience for all participants.

feeds.title: USA Softball of Southern California
feeds.description: USA Softball of Southern California is an affiliate of USA Softball, the National Governing Body of Softball in the United States and a United States Olympic Committee (USOC) voting member. USA Softball of Southern California organizes youth clinics, umpire seminars and conducts national qualifying tournaments in slow pitch and fast pitch for men, women and youth.

feeds.title: Mount Horeb Softball Club Blog
feeds.description: The purpose of the Mount Horeb Softball Club is to promote the growth of girls softball from youth through high school ages, at all levels of competition, within the Mount Horeb community. The development of sportsmanship, teamwork, and respect for others are key priorities. The MHSC will promote fundamentals of the game while fostering a fun and positive softball experience.

feeds.title: Hanover Senior Softball
feeds.description: Hanover Senior Softball (HSS) provides an opportunity for men 50 years of age or over and women 40 years of age and over to play competitive slow pitch softball in a friendly and safe environment.

feeds.title: Softball Spot
feeds.description: Softball Spot features more than 582 free softball drills for hitting, pitching, fielding, baserunning and conditioning. Everything you need to engage your girls in practice, improve their skills, and win more softball games!

feeds.title: Fastpitch Power
feeds.description: The premier source for online instruction, strength training, and video analysis for windmill pitchers, fastpitch softball players, and coaches. Our mission is to develop softball players into top level, NCAA recruited pitchers and athletes. Furthermore we aim to educate the general public on proper pitching mechanics, techniques, and general softball skills.

feeds.title: Softball Galaxy Blog
feeds.description: Discover fun, interesting quirks about the Softball life and gift recommendations. Softball Galaxy Blog written by a family of four Softball enthusiasts brings out updates and listicles to help you with all your Softball questions and needs. Stay relevantly updated on Softball news and merchandise with new posts.

feeds.title: Glory Fastpitch Softball
feeds.description: The Glory was founded to bring out the greatness in our sport and each other by growing a Purpose Driven Softball movement and community. We believe it takes giving and talented people working together with servant's hearts to reach our fullest potential.

feeds.title: Justin's World of Softball
feeds.description: Justin's World of Softball is proud to unveil the new online home for all of JWOS' critically-acclaimed softball coverage. As we prepared for our coverage of the 2018 preseason and regular season, it became glaringly obvious that a new site with better features and easier navigability was going to be a necessity sooner rather than later.

feeds.title: The Wheatland Spikes Blog
feeds.description: The Wheatland Spikes is a competitive Girls Fast Pitch Softball program for players 7-18 years old. The teams compete in the fall, spring and summer and train indoors at our Spikes Training Center October through March.

feeds.title: Softball Ace
feeds.description: Comprehensive reviews and information on the best softball gloves. Reviews for fastptich and slowpitch gloves and all positions including infield and other softball equipment.

feeds.title: Mountain West Softball Blog
feeds.description: A Mountain West fan blog, written and created by and for fans of Fresno State softball.

feeds.title: Wesley Wolverines Fastpitch Softball
feeds.description: This blog celebrates the Wesley College fastpitch team, its players and the wonderful game of collegiate softball. It presents strictly positive, bolstering reports about the Wolverine squad as well as'can-do' motivational softball news and information from around the web.

feeds.title: The Diamond Dish
feeds.description: Everything gay softball across North America! Providing in depth information, news and notes about NAGAAA affiliated leagues and tournaments including the yearly GSWS.

feeds.title: BlueFire Softball :: Girls Fastpitch Softball Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to BlueFire Girls Fastpitch Softball. Our players have developed over the years into very competitive and respectful teams throughout Long Island and beyond. During the years, BlueFire Softball girls captured some great victories. Our pyramid philosophy of success has guided us through the years. BlueFire Softball is routinely competing all day during elimination round games.

feeds.title: Springville High School Softball
feeds.description: Find latest updates from springville high school softball.

feeds.title: HBCU Softball
feeds.description: I am from Tocoa Falls, GA. Having daughters that played softball growing up at HBCU colleges, I have developed a love for it and continue to follow the MEAC,SWAC, CIAA, and SIAC around as well as following them via the internet. Blog by Byron Mayfield.

feeds.title: GalsSoftball | Cabrillo GALS Fast Pitch Softball
feeds.description: Cabrillo GALS is a fastpitch softball league started in 1987. We are a non-profit organization that is run completely by volunteers. Cabrillo GALS is open to kids ages 5 to 15 at all skill levels living in Santa Cruz County. Generous donations from people like you will provide our local kids with wonderful opportunities to make new friendships, to learn and improve their skills.

feeds.title: On Deck Sports Blog
feeds.description: A blog for baseball & softball coaches and players as well as indoor sports facility owners and managers. On Deck Sports has continued to create innovative products for the demanding baseball and softball industries. Additionally, On Deck Sports has designed and constructed over 1,000 indoor facilities nationwide.

feeds.title: Softball Western Australia
feeds.description: Softball Western Australia Inc. is the governing body for softball in WA & is affiliated to Softball Australia Ltd. There are some 14 associations with over 100 clubs providing the game to over 5000 players and officials. The objects of the Association are to grow the game of softball through equitable and inclusive practices that provide opportunities for participation at all levels in softball.

feeds.title: PlaySoftball
feeds.description: PlaySoftball is your one-stop place for recruiting new softball players, advertising open positions, finding a team for your Softball Player, or advertising your Fastpitch Clinic or Camp. Our mission is to connect coaches, players, and parents in order to grow the game of softball.

feeds.title: Pleasant Hill Baseball Association
feeds.description: The purpose of this association shall be to promote, equip, govern and sponsor baseball and softball as played by youth 4 years of age and over using the doctrine of Positive Coaching. Enjoyment of the game shall be the basic goal of all participants and all efforts will be directed toward having each member of each team play baseball or softball.

feeds.title: Redondo Sunset League - News
feeds.description: Redondo Sunset is a 501c3 non profit charity that provides organized baseball and girls softball to local youth in the south Redondo Beach area. We are affiliated with PONY Baseball which plays PONY rules baseball or real baseball. PONY rules are closely aligned to MLB rules and we are affiliated with USA softball and play USA softball rules for girls softball.

feeds.title: USA SOFTBALL GEORGIA
feeds.description: The official blog of Georgia ASA Softball. Learn more about Georgia ASA. Focus on financial and organization effectiveness that enhances our service, products and image. Ensure our future success as the leader in softball by improving the leadership and governance of our organization.

feeds.title: The Woodlands High School Softball
feeds.description: Home of the TWHS Fast Pitch Softball Team. Stay updated with latest news and information from the Woodlands High School Softball.

feeds.title: Milton Girls Softball
feeds.description: Milton Girls Softball is an independent, non-profit organization committed to providing all girls with an experience that fosters positive self-esteem, team spirit and individual growth through personal achievement and team play. Our goal is for each player to have fun while gaining knowledge of the game.

feeds.title: Herndon Reston Youth Softball
feeds.description: HRYS is a girls' fastpitch softball league serving players ages 5 to 18 in the greater Herndon-Reston, Virginia area. Separate spring and fall competitive house seasons are run with the objective of serving all the girls of the community.

feeds.title: Northern Virginia Girls Softball Association
feeds.description: NVGSA is devoted exclusively to Fastpitch Softball for girls! We offer both House League and Select levels of play for girls ages 5 to 18.

feeds.title: MCSSL Softball
feeds.description: News and information from MCSSL Softball. The Montgomery County Senior Softball League is a Slow Pitch League that had its beginnings in March of 1999. It has ten teams, a travel team, and a winter indoor division. The league is made up of male players 60 years of age and older, whose skills may not have kept pace with their enjoyment of the game.
